roles.title: Software Engineer, AI Product Engineering
roles.description: Works on the Network Investigation Workspace, an AI product for incident investigation, evidence retrieval, and saved findings.
highlights: Owned full stack delivery from product discovery to production, building React/TypeScript interfaces, Python/FastAPI services, and PostgreSQL data models for evidence-backed incident investigations.
Iterated on streaming answers, inspectable citations, and visible progress using pilot feedback; increased weekly active usage from 38% to 71% of enabled users.
Built LangGraph workflows for evidence retrieval and diagnostic tool calls with durable checkpoints, approval validation, and stable operation identifiers to avoid duplicate execution.
Evaluated retrieval quality, agent tool selection, and argument validity on held-out tasks; improved context selection and validation, increasing task completion from 82% to 94%.
Delivered AWS releases with Docker, GitHub Actions, and regression tests; monitored errors and latency and verified AI-assisted code changes through review and integration testing.

roles.title: Member of Technical Staff, Backend Systems
roles.description: Worked on the Infrastructure Investigation Dashboard, a web product for event visibility, diagnostics, and investigation workflows.
highlights: Built Python REST APIs and asynchronous workers to ingest infrastructure events, validate schemas, and preserve searchable PostgreSQL event histories.
Developed React/TypeScript interfaces with live processing status, event filters, and failure drilldowns to streamline operational investigations.
Designed restart-safe processing with stable event identifiers, PostgreSQL uniqueness constraints, and bounded retry handling.
Investigated inefficient SQL queries and missing indexes, reducing p95 API latency from 800 ms to 310 ms under the measured workload.
Added pytest integration tests and automated release checks to catch regressions in event ingestion, persistence, and API behavior.
